description.en:
A vehicle-free flyover camera for editing AutoDrive route networks.
Requires FS25_AutoDrive to be installed and active. This mod does not modify AutoDrive; it attaches to it at runtime and refuses to load if it cannot.
STAGE 5a - adds the field-loop generator and the undo history. There is no editor yet.
Console: FlyoverStatus, FlyoverGeomTest, FlyoverFakeActive, FlyoverProxyAt, FlyoverProxyOff.
